transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um... well, it's mostly because of my wife. She gets frustrated with me. She'll be telling me about things... like my cousin's appointments, or rides he needs, and I'm looking right at her. But... a minute later I realize I didn't actually take in half of what she said. So... I guess I'm here about that.
Does this happen only when your wife is talking to you, or do you find yourself having trouble paying attention to other people or situations as well?

No, it's other things too. Um... like if I sit down to work out a catering order, or... if I'm listening in on a parish planning call. 

I start off fine, I guess. But before long, my mind just... wanders. I end up having to go back over the same notes like I never even read them in the first place. So... yeah. It's not just her.
Do you feel anxious or overwhelmed when your mind wanders and you have to go back over the same information?
Um... no, I wouldn't say anxious. I just... realize I missed it, so I go back and read it again. That's about it.
Do you often find yourself fidgeting or feeling restless?
No, not really. I just sit there.
Do you often feel like you're moving or tapping your hands or feet when you're sitting still?
No. I don't really do that either.
Do you feel upset or sad when you realize you've missed information?
No. It doesn't really bother me like that. I just... go back and read it again.
Do you usually have trouble finishing tasks or projects you start?

Yeah, I guess. I'll start something simple... like setting up my cousin's pill organizer, or cleaning the prep table after I cook. And then... I just notice later that I left one or two steps unfinished.
Do you have trouble keeping your workspace or living space organized?
No, not really. I mean... things are mostly where they belong. It's fine.
Do you often interrupt others when they're talking?
No, I don't think so. I usually just... let people finish what they're saying.
Do you often blurting out answers before questions have been finished?
No, not really. I... I usually wait until they're done.
Do you find it hard to focus on one thing for a long time?

I suppose. Um... if I sit down to work out a catering order, or... if I'm listening through a parish planning call... I usually start off fine. But before long, my mind just sort of wanders. I end up having to go back over the same notes... like I never even read them. So... yeah, I guess I do.
Do you often feel impatient when you have to wait for something?
No, not really. I don't mind waiting. I usually just... sit quietly, I suppose. It doesn't bother me much.
Did you have a lot of energy or act restless when you were a child?
No, I don't think so. I was... pretty quiet, mostly. Just sort of kept to myself.
Did you have trouble paying attention or sitting still when you were in school?

Sitting still wasn't really an issue. I was always quiet. But... paying attention, I suppose so. 

Even way back in grade school... before I was twelve... I know teachers used to tell my parents I was bright, but... they said I was always daydreaming. I'd, um... leave my homework sitting in my desk. And they always had to remind me to actually finish my classwork. So... yes, I guess I did.
Have you always had trouble paying attention, or did it start at some point later in your life?
I suppose it's just... always been this way. Like I said, even when I was a kid, the teachers noticed it. It's not something that just started recently. It's just... how I am, I guess.
Did you ever get into trouble in school for being too active or restless?
No. Like I said, I was quiet. I didn't cause trouble.
Did you ever feel like you were more active or had more energy than your peers when you were a child?
No, not really. I... I didn't have a lot of energy like that. I mostly just kept to myself.
Do you feel like your trouble paying attention and finishing tasks is causing problems for you at work or in your relationships?

Well... yeah. I guess it is. My wife... she gets frustrated. We help take care of my cousin, and she feels like she can't really rely on me for that. And, uh, I do some small catering jobs here and there... I end up having to redo things or double-check everything so I don't mess up the orders. So... yeah, it causes some issues.
Did you ever get in trouble for running, climbing, or playing too rough when you were a kid?
No... I wasn't really a rough kid. I didn't do much of that.
Did you have any symptoms of inattention or hyperactivity as a child that caused significant problems for you?

I guess... yeah. Back in grade school, before I was 12 or so... my teachers would tell my parents I was bright, but... I was just always daydreaming. I'd, uh, leave my homework in my desk a lot. They always had to remind me to finish my classwork. So... I suppose that was an issue.
